page.layout: One column of names with years, set between a vertical rule; years stand in the left margin beside each group. Two marginal notes in the right margin, beside 1309 and 1311. Printed page number at the top right. No running head, catchword or signature text beyond the gathering mark at the foot.

main_text.l: 1309 | Alardus Papinga. Fœdus civitatis Groning. cum Drentinis.
1311 | Ludbertus Hedinge. Bellum ad Ullenhoam inter Frisios, & episcop. Ultraiect.

page.notes: Years stand in the left margin beside their groups and are written in the first line of each group. The signature at the foot is partly unclear. The right-margin notes are set in small type and are transcribed as printed, with "Vullenhoam" and "Vltraiect." normalised to u/v usage (Ullenhoam, Ultraiect). The name "Beijerus" may read "Beijerus"; the j is uncertain.
